description: Null distribution of canonical P1 loop geometry across random Arg/Lys sites in 16 unrelated structures, to calibrate the PI15 result
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os, itertools
AA3to1=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"))
def parse(path, chain=None, lo=None, hi=None):
    out=[]
    for line in open(path):
        if line.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if not line.startswith('ATOM'): continue
        if line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        if chain and line[21]!=chain: continue
        rn=line[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3to1: continue
        el=(line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
        if el=='H': continue
        r=int(line[22:26])
        if lo is not None and (r<lo or r>hi): continue
        out.append((line[12:16].strip(),rn,line[21],r,np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])))
    return out
def bb(atoms,chain,s,e):
    o=[]
    for r in range(s,e+1):
        d={a[0]:a[4] for a in atoms if a[3]==r and a[2]==chain}
        if not all(k in d for k in ('N','CA','C','O')): return None
        o+=[d['N'],d['CA'],d['C'],d['O']]
    return np.array(o)
def krms(P,Q):
    pm,qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
    V,S,W=np.linalg.svd((P-pm).T@(Q-qm)); U=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W))])@W
    return float(np.sqrt((((P-pm)@U-(Q-qm))**2).sum()/len(P)))
T={'BPTI':bb(parse('work/5PTI.pdb','A'),'A',13,18),
   'OMTKY3':bb(parse('work/1CHO.pdb','I'),'I',16,21),
   'PSTI':bb(parse('work/1TGS.pdb','I'),'I',16,21),
   'APPI':bb(parse('work/1EAW.pdb','B'),'B',13,18)}

# null set: unrelated secreted / soluble proteins
null_ids=['1UBQ','3CHY','1CRN','1LYZ','1MBN','2LYZ','1HHO','1A3N','4LZT','1RNB','1PGB','5CYT','1BPI','1IGD','1SHG','2CI2']
for p in null_ids:
    f=f'work/{p}.pdb'
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        c=requests.get(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb',timeout=90)
        if c.status_code==200: open(f,'wb').write(c.content)
def scan_all(path, chain=None, lo=None, hi=None):
    at=parse(path,chain,lo,hi)
    if not at: return []
    ch=chain or at[0][2]; at=[a for a in at if a[2]==ch]
    out=[]
    for r in sorted(set(a[3] for a in at)):
        nm=[a[1] for a in at if a[3]==r][0]
        if nm not in ('ARG','LYS'): continue
        f=bb(at,ch,r-2,r+3)
        if f is None: continue
        out.append(min(krms(f,t) for t in T.values()))
    return out
null=[]
for p in null_ids:
    f=f'work/{p}.pdb'
    if os.path.exists(f): null += scan_all(f)
null=np.array(null)
pi15=np.array(scan_all('work/PI15_human.pdb',None,61,258))
cap_bg=np.array(scan_all('work/CRISP3_human.pdb')+scan_all('work/GLIPR1_human.pdb')+scan_all('work/PI16_human.pdb'))
true_p1=[krms(bb(parse('work/2PTC.pdb','I'),'I',13,18),T['OMTKY3']),
         krms(bb(parse('work/1TGS.pdb','I'),'I',16,21),T['BPTI']),
         krms(bb(parse('work/1CHO.pdb','I'),'I',16,21),T['BPTI']),
         krms(bb(parse('work/1EAW.pdb','B'),'B',13,18),T['PSTI'])]
print(f'Null set: {len(null_ids)} unrelated structures, {len(null)} Arg/Lys sites.')
print(f'  null min {null.min():.2f}, 1st pct {np.percentile(null,1):.2f}, 5th pct {np.percentile(null,5):.2f}, median {np.median(null):.2f}')
print(f'True canonical P1 sites (leave-one-out vs other templates): {[round(x,2) for x in true_p1]}')
print(f'  all true P1 sites fall below the {100*np.mean(null<max(true_p1)):.2f}th percentile of the null')
print(f'PI15 mature chain: n={len(pi15)} Arg/Lys, best {pi15.min():.2f} -> percentile in null = {100*np.mean(null<pi15.min()):.1f}')
print(f'CAP paralog background (CRISP3+GLIPR1+PI16): n={len(cap_bg)}, best {cap_bg.min():.2f}')
print(f'\nEmpirical p for "PI15 contains a canonical P1 loop": P(null site <= 1.37) = {np.mean(null<=pi15.min()):.3f} '
      f'-> a 1.37 A match is what ~{100*np.mean(null<=pi15.min()):.0f}% of random Arg/Lys sites achieve by chance.')
np.save('work/null_rmsd.npy',null)
pd.DataFrame(dict(source=['null_random']*len(null)+['PI15']*len(pi15)+['CAP_paralogs']*len(cap_bg),
                  rmsd=list(null)+list(pi15)+list(cap_bg))).to_csv('work/p1_loop_null_distribution.csv',index=False)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.5))
ax.hist(null,bins=40,color='#bbbbbb',label=f'random Arg/Lys sites in {len(null_ids)} unrelated proteins (n={len(null)})')
for v in true_p1: ax.axvline(v,color='#2ca02c',lw=2)
ax.axvline(pi15.min(),color='#d62728',lw=2.5)
ax.annotate('true canonical P1 sites\n(0.26-0.62 A)',(0.45,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.75),color='#2ca02c',fontsize=9,ha='center')
ax.annotate(f'best PI15 site\nArg131, {pi15.min():.2f} A',(pi15.min()+0.05,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.55),color='#d62728',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("backbone RMSD of a P3-P3' segment to canonical inhibitor loops (A)")
ax.set_ylabel('number of Arg/Lys sites')
ax.set_title('The best PI15 arginine is an ordinary turn, not a reactive-site loop',fontsize=11,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
